metrics.acceptance: experiment q20_accept: zero-shot and every candidate on init states 0-9, 10 episodes, noise seed 5; keep the most successes, ties to the policy, then the earlier candidate

hypotheses.H1: order A: kept > zero-shot pooled over 48 arrivals (exact sign test)

metrics.motivation: q17_stream: one prototype per type points at its source's instance; q19_inst (exploratory): instances chosen by practice recover the back and middle bowls with a foreign prototype
metrics.reported: demonstrations requested (planned {"A": 15, "B": 15} of 48), bytes, forms kept
metrics.rule: as q17_stream: an arrival whose object type is not in the library requests one demonstration, used once (its 4 KB prototype joins the library and is its only candidate); an arrival whose type is known requests nothing and its candidates are the library's prototype of the type at each of 4 instances: the prototype's cosine map over the policy's image patches cut into its 4 strongest peaks at least 3 patches apart, ordered row-major, the r-th tracked through the episode (bindw4@rho0.7_approach_src<k>_inst<r>_npk4)
metrics.test: experiment q20_main: kept arm and zero-shot on init states 30-49, 20 episodes, noise seed 5
metrics.written_before: any episode of q20_accept or q20_main
